requirements.R_WRITE_PRIMARY: Mutating checkout paths persist only on the fenced writer shop file.
requirements.R_REPLICA_READONLY: Standby does not keep stray checkout mutations from the API.
requirements.R_STICKY_PIN: Recent writers read from the writer until the sticky window expires; idle reads follow seq eligibility.
requirements.R_LAG_GATE: Standby reads are refused when applied seq is behind the configured gap budget.
requirements.R_PIN_STORE: Sticky keys live on cache alias pins, visible across AZ settings and independent of either shop file.
requirements.R_FENCE_EPOCH: Exactly one writable writer exists; cutover bumps epoch and demotes the previous owner.
requirements.R_IDEMPOTENT_EFFECT: Capture side effects are unique per checkout attempt id across retry and dual-box replay.
requirements.R_READYZ: /readyz is distinct from /healthz and fails on double-writer or unsafe seq gap.
requirements.R_STATUS_DUMP: failover-status.json matches the runbook object and refuses accepting_checkout during split writer.
requirements.R_STATUS_COUNTS: failover-status.json reports repeat captures and does not claim incident coverage while duplicates remain.
requirements.R_APPLY_STANDBY: sync_standby advances standby seq without copying a writable fence lease.
requirements.R_RESTART: After connection/cache restart, epoch and pins still enforce the same contract.
